answer: Tie every agent earning power to one bonded identity whose history is mapped like an atlas: a newcomer locks a small refundable stake and builds verifiable work over time before its weight counts, while a rotating cipher challenge proves one operator cannot clone the bond across fake accounts. Identities on the ledge of suspicion, sudden bursts of identical behaviour, get their weight frozen until established peers vouch for them, so a thousand puppets cost a thousand stakes and yield nothing.
